set_rng_seeds: set random number generator seeds for torch, cuda, random, and numpy modules using a single integer
get_rng_states: get a dictionary of current RNG states from torch, cuda, random, and numpy for later restoration
top_p_filtering: filter logits using nucleus top-p sampling to keep only tokens with cumulative probability above a threshold
explore_ratio: apply eps-force mutation ratio to probability distributions to prevent self-mutations and cap old token probability
modify_logits: modify logits with masking, nucleus sampling, epsilon greedy bypass, temperature scaling, and mutation ratio controls
